ffa.name: Free-For-All
ffa.description: Everyone for themselves. First to the score limit.

tdm.name: Team Deathmatch
tdm.description: Two teams of four. Kills score for your team.

ctf.name: Capture the Flag
ctf.description: Take their flag home. The carrier can't strike but can dash - escort them.

clash.name: Faction Clash
clash.description: Three factions, one map. Kills score, and so does holding the moving zone alone.

elim.name: Elimination
elim.description: One life per round. Wipe the other team. First to 3 rounds.
